enabled.description: Whether to enable project view counters

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the counter API service

fallbackOnError.description: Whether to show fallback counters if API fails

trackEvents.description: Which interactions increment a counter. Unlisted events are not counted.

projectMapping.description: Configuration for mapping projects to counter endpoints

note.description: Documentation note for project mapping configuration

autoGenerate.description: Whether to automatically generate project mappings from repository names

customMappings.description: Custom mappings from repository names to CounterAPI project names
